description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the HolidayService class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It tests functionalities such as getting/setting the HolidayDao, saving holiday objects, and searching holidays with various filters including recurring, date ranges, pagination, and ensuring uniqueness of results.

classes.name: HolidayServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Leave HolidayService logic, including CRUD operations and search filters with unit tests and result comparisons.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including setting up the fixture path, creating an instance of HolidayService, and clearing cache.

methods.name: testGetSetHolidayDao
methods.description: Verifies that the HolidayService correctly returns an instance of HolidayDao.

methods.name: testSaveHoliday
methods.description: Tests saving a Holiday object via the HolidayService and ensures the returned object matches expectations.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysNoneRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching for non-recurring holidays within a date range and verifies the returned list matches expected holidays.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringCurrentYear
methods.description: Tests searching for holidays with some recurring entries within the year 2010 and verifies proper filtering.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringOtherYear
methods.description: Tests filtering of recurring and non-recurring holidays outside the target year to see if only relevant holidays are returned.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringMultiYear
methods.description: Validates holiday search results across multiple years, ensuring multi-year filters work as expected.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysPartYear
methods.description: Checks filtering of holidays within a partial year and across multiple years, including multi-year recurrence.

methods.name: compareHolidays
methods.description: Custom assertion to compare two lists of Holiday objects for equality.

methods.name: compareHoliday
methods.description: Asserts equality of individual Holiday objects based on recurrence, name, date, and length.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysCheckUniqueness
methods.description: Ensures that the search correctly handles duplicates and applies offset/limit for pagination.
